t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Look for patterns as early as possible. Patterns change each round. If a gnome is low paying, switch to the other gnome as this is a pattern for that round.

vb_textbox.text: High paying gnomes for each round don't seem to be randomly selected. If you find that a certain gnome pays highly, stick with that gnome throughout the round. You will typically have success this way. When a new round starts, determine which gnome is high paying and stick with it. This changes between rounds.
